name: Claude for Manufacturing
desc: Plugin of skills and connectors for plant teams
desc_zh: 面向工厂团队的技能与连接器插件
solves: Estimators dig through old jobs and ERP screens for one quote; the plugin reads requests and drafts it from records.
solves_zh: 报价员要在旧工单和 ERP 里翻资料，插件读取需求后据记录起草报价。
best_for: A quote request lands and you need a costed estimate from similar jobs before the customer calls again.
best_for_zh: 客户发来询价，想在对方催之前参照相似工单给出成本估算。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 A Claude plugin with connectors to Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365 and Oracle NetSuite.
